name: Inkling (975B)

moe.router: sigmoid scores with bias for top-6; the router also scores the 2 shared experts and their weights are normalised together ('shared expert sink'); route scale 8

stack.note: config local_layer_ids: global at 0-based 5, 11, ... 65, so the last layer is global; layers 0-1 dense FFN

steps.label: q,k RMS-normed per head, scale 1/d; k and v pass short convs; learned relative bias (d_rel 16); local: 16 KV heads, window 512 / global: 8 KV heads, full, log-length scaling
2 shared + top-6 of 256 SwiGLU experts (dense SwiGLU 24576 in layers 1-2)

specials.name: short_conv
specials.what: four depthwise causal convolutions of kernel 4 per layer, each with its own skip: on keys, on values, after attention, after the MLP

specials.name: relative_bias
specials.what: fourth projection r (d_rel 16 per head) gives a learned distance term added to scores; extent 1024 on global, 512 on local layers

specials.name: log_length_scaling
specials.what: queries and bias scaled by 1 + 0.1 log(n / 128,000) beyond 128K positions

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: 8 MTP layers; their attention is local in 6 of them (config mtp_config)

specials.name: output_scale
specials.what: final hidden state divided by 24 (logits_mup_width_multiplier) before the head

omitted_towers.what: hierarchical MLP patchifier (hMLP), 40x40 px patches, temporal patch 2 for video
dMel: 100 ms chunks turned into discrete mel bins (80 bins, 16 levels) and embedded; no encoder layers

idx.note: attn k_sconv/v_sconv, rel_logits_proj, q_norm/k_norm; attn_sconv, mlp_sconv; mtp.layers 0-7; visual 4 linear layers

post.note: dMel audio, four-layer hMLP on 40x40 patches; 45T tokens

code.note: InklingDecoderLayer and InklingAttention: sconv placement, relative logits, log scaling, shared-expert routing

ccfg.note: hidden_act silu; dense_intermediate_size is the dense MLP width

hfblog.note: Hugging Face explainer: relative attention, 5:1 hybrid, SConv, shared expert sink

nv.note: NVIDIA NIM page: 'a Mamba-hybrid, 256-expert MoE', 952B parameters

gal.note: entry 'Inkling': date, licence name, cross-check only

notes: NVIDIA's NIM page calls Inkling 'a Mamba-hybrid' with 952B parameters. The config, weight index and transformers code show a local/global GQA stack with short convolutions and no Mamba layers, and the model card says 975B; the record follows them.
Inkling 2 Small's record now reads its block from transformers' inkling2 code; both models apply the post-sublayer short convolutions before the residual add.

local.note: relative bias extent 512; layers 1-2 have a dense FFN

global.note: full context; relative bias extent 1024; log-length scaling
